description: What the tel: fixture contains and why. Each entry has an id (its title), the field its value sits in, and either a 'value' of its own (a UI-only entry) or 'valueFrom' a case id of app/src/sharedTest/resources/tel-link-cases.json. 'scenarios' name the UI scenarios that use the entry; if left out they follow from the case (links expected: UI-LINK, UI-LONGPRESS, UI-CALL; no link: UI-NOLINK). The Notes field of every entry holds the instructions, built from the scenarios and from the case; for an entry that tests the Notes field, the tested value is the last line. Run 'uv run python populate.py' to build the database, 'uv run python check_alignment.py' to check that spec, cases and database agree.

database.why: The password is a documented test value, not a secret. User verification off: the per-database toggle of KeePassDX, which removes the system prompt before an entry can be edited. Modifiable: the Edit button exists only for a database that is not read-only; the tests never save.

dialogs.name: discard-changes
dialogs.why: Leaving edit mode asks this. A test never saves.

dialogs.name: lock-discard
dialogs.why: Locking asks this when the database holds unsaved changes. A test never saves, so nothing is lost; seeing it at all means something edited the database, and the report shows the rule used.

dialogs.name: database-changed

match.text_contains: has been modified outside the app

dialogs.why: The file changed on the phone while the app held it open (a push or a sync). OK only reads it again. Initialize closes the apps before the push, so this means the close step did not work.

dialogs.name: reload-discards

match.text_contains: Reloading the database will delete the locally modified data

dialogs.why: A reload that would throw away local changes. Cancel changes nothing.

dialogs.name: notification-permission

match.text_contains: The notification permission allows you to display the status of the database

dialogs.why: Android 13 asks once. Later does not open the system permission dialog and does not change a setting.

dialogs.name: clipboard-first-time

match.text_contains: The clipboard is shared by all apps

dialogs.why: First tap on Copy of a protected field. Disable keeps the default (clipboard trust off).

dialogs.name: password-encoding

match.text_contains: Avoid password characters outside of text encoding

dialogs.why: The unlock password has unusual characters. test123 never does; Cancel changes nothing.

dialogs.name: duplicate-uuid
dialogs.why: The fixture is broken. Cancel, and the run fails at the unlock.

dialogs.name: mail-draft
dialogs.why: A tap on an e-mail address opens a composer; leaving it asks this. A test never saves a draft.

dialogs.name: popup-menu
dialogs.why: An overflow menu or a dropdown is a window named PopupWindow:<hash>, without an activity. It is not a modal to wait for: Back closes it.

dialogs.name: notification-shade
dialogs.why: The notification panel covers the app and makes the screen dump fail. Closing it is a technical step.

dialogs.name: screen-locked
dialogs.why: The phone locked itself. Only the person can unlock it; the test waits for them.

dialogs.name: user-verification
dialogs.why: Android asks the person to verify (PIN or fingerprint) before an entry can be edited. The test never enters a PIN: it waits for the person.

UI-LINK.title: The link in view mode
steps: Open the entry in view mode and look at the value. Which characters are underlined?

UI-TAP.title: Tap
steps: Tap the underlined number. Android may ask which app opens it; choose the Phone app. Look at the dialpad: does it hold the number? Do NOT press the call button. Go back.

UI-LONGPRESS.title: Long-press
steps: Long-press the underlined number. Which characters are highlighted? Which buttons does the toolbar show?

UI-CALL.title: Call in the selection toolbar
steps: After the long-press tap Call in the toolbar. What does the dialpad hold? Do NOT press the call button. Go back.

UI-LONGPRESS-TWO.title: Long-press with two numbers
steps: Long-press the second number only. Is only that number highlighted? Tap Call: does the dialpad hold only the second number? Do NOT press the call button.

UI-WRAP.title: A number that wraps over two lines
steps: The number is long enough to wrap. Is the underline continuous over both lines? Tap the part on the second line. Long-press the part on the second line: is the whole number highlighted?

UI-NOTEL.title: No phone link where only another link is expected
steps: Look at the value: only the web address or e-mail address may be a link, no part of it a phone link. A tap on the part with the number must open the web address, not the dialer. Go back.

UI-NOLINK.title: No link where none is expected
steps: Look at the value: nothing may be underlined. Long-press the value: a single word is highlighted, as in any text.

UI-WEB.title: A web link
steps: Tap the underlined address. Does the browser open? Go back.

UI-MAIL.title: An e-mail link
steps: Is only the address underlined, and not the word in front of it? Tap it: does a mail app open? Go back without sending.

UI-REOPEN.title: Reopen the entry
steps: Go back to the list and open the entry again. Is it shown exactly as before?

UI-EDIT.title: Edit mode
steps: Tap the pencil. In edit mode the value is a plain text field: no underline, the full text. Leave edit mode WITHOUT saving.

UI-COPY.title: Copy button
steps: Tap the copy button next to the value, then paste somewhere (for example into a note app). What was copied: the whole value or only a part?

entries.expected: Only the number after the prefix is underlined, the prefix is plain. A tap and Call lead to the dialpad with the number only.
A custom field has no link in the first iterations.
The Notes field has no link in the first iterations.
The whole address is underlined; a long-press highlights the whole address.
Only the address after mailto: is underlined; a long-press highlights only the address.
A bare number has no link.

entries.value: tel:+49301234567 is the number to call, this text only makes the line longer
entries.expected: The number is at the start of the text. Only the number is underlined and highlighted.

entries.value: this text comes first, then tel:+49301234567 and then more text follows
entries.expected: The number is in the middle of the text. Only the number is underlined and highlighted.

entries.value: a text that ends with the number: tel:+49301234567
entries.expected: The number is at the end of the text. Only the number is underlined and highlighted.
Both numbers are underlined, each on its own; a long-press highlights only the one touched.
The number wraps over two lines, the underline is continuous, a tap or a long-press on the second line works on the whole number.
Edit mode shows the plain text, no link. The copy button copies the whole value including the prefix.
Only +1 is underlined. A long-press highlights only +1, not tel:. The toolbar offers Call, and Call gives the dialer +1.
